messages:
nina: Quick idea: 'usage-stability buffer' to reduce churn from short spikes. baseline still commit-based but we absorb small short-lived overages before applying add-ons. sketch below.

arpit: sounds promising. two design Qs: how large is the buffer and how long does it hold?

nina: proposal: buffer = max(1% of baseline, 50k tokens) held for 7 days. if overage persists beyond 7d rolling, convert to add-on charge. buffer resets each billing cycle.

jyoti: product notes: need console toggle per-customer + clear explainer in billing UI. For Dedicated customers make it opt-in only. Also add telemetry to show "buffer used" vs "true overage".

melissa: engineering: implement as a reconciliation step in invoice job. lightweight state per-customer: buffer_remaining and buffer_expiry. metric names: billing_buffer_used, billing_buffer_expiry_days. estimate 2 sprints incl. tests and console hooks.

legal-bot: Reminder: changes that affect charges require 45-day notice and updated TOS language. Pilots OK with opt-in recordings.

jyoti: launch criteria: 1) RFC + migration playbook 2) console UI + toggle 3) billing simulation against 12 months of history showing delta 4) legal signoff 5) 2 pilot customers.

nina: I'll draft RFC and mockups. @melissa please prototype invoice reconciliation flow. @arpit can you run a simulation on historical data and share delta? I'll add to Q3 roadmap after PM review. :thumbsup:
